body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 377fbd9b2531b02ea58fa7e6c95dbcf2874c2658 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a SAFETY-tier review. The PR adds geometry and an NC golden. It changes no production machining code.

What looks good:

- The case has all required files and uses existing commands.
- The project opens with its embedded mesh and no repair notes.
- I checked all 110 lines of the new NC golden. The groove diameters, blade offsets, pecks, retracts, and operation order match the script.
- An independent mesh check found 290 vertices and 576 nondegenerate triangles. The mesh is closed and has outward orientation.
- The README states the holder limitation. No UI code changes require screenshots.

Results locally, against upstream/main `61a817bed26bf42bf285638d5db337980bea6d0b`:

- The trial merge is clean. Main is already an ancestor of this head.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: all three steps passed. The build passed, `catalog_groove_part_off` passed 1 test, and `example_catalog` passed 5 tests.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `cargo xtask catalog --check`: all six cases reproduced their NC programs.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run`: the diff reaches no heavy lane.

Extra suites run:

- `example_catalog`: 5 passed. This suite reads the changed catalog fixtures and ran in the quick gate.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --test catalog_render`, from `crates/ui`: 1 passed, 1 intentionally ignored screenshot renderer.
- No importer code or STEP fixture changed. The extra importer suites do not apply.

Mutations repeated locally:

1. Changed both rough plunges from X22.5 to X23.5. The new test failed at line 37. The restored fixture passed.
2. Changed every part-off endpoint from X0 to X1. The new test failed at line 46. The restored fixture passed.

These mutations check the fixture assertions. They do not test a new production guard. The NC file was restored byte for byte.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes: No physical machining or GUI session ran. The compiler cache stopped during the UI build; local compilation completed successfully.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Merge class: SAME (no commit after the reviewed head). This merge relies on the review by mkinney with the marker for head `377fbd9b2531b02ea58fa7e6c95dbcf2874c2658`. The PR changes tests, examples and a decision file only.
